name: Cleric Shadowpiercer
body:
Some clerics serve their deity’s interest in the furthest corners of the realm. Gaining new ways to channel their divine power to aid their journeys into the dark.

Shadowtrained: A shadowpiercer gains Bluff, Disguise, and Stealth as class skills and gains an additional 2 skill points per class level. A shadowpiercer does not gain proficiency with medium armor or shields.

Diminished Spellcasting

A shadowpiercer focuses more on leveraging other divine gifts and is granted fewer spells by their deity. At each level the shadowpiercer can prepare one fewer spell per spell level per day than normal. If this results in the spells per day for a level being 0, the shadowpiercer may still prepare spells of that level if they are granted bonus spells per day due to a high ability score, this does not affect the domain spell slot granted to the shadowpiercer.

This ability affects spellcasting.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 1st level a shadowpiercer deals additional damage to targets which are flat-footed or denied their Dexterity bonus to armor class as well against creatures they are flanking. At 1st level the shadowpiercer deals an additional 1d6 precision damage on weapon attacks which meet these requirements as long as the shadowpiercer is within 30 feet of their target.

This additional damage can be dealt as non lethal damage if made with a weapon such as a sap or whip which would normally only deal non lethal damage.

This damage increases by 1d6 at for every 4 levels beyond 1st.

This ability replaces spontaneous spellcasting.

Beacon (Su)

At 1st level the shadowpiercer can channel energy to cast some light spells. They may spend a move action to expend a number of channel energy uses equal to the spells level and cast one of the following spells: faerie fire, daylight, pillar of life.

Shade Your Spirit (Su)

At times a shadowpiercer is required to blend into the very shadows they aim to banish. At 3rd level, they may expend a use of channel energy as a swift action to gain a bonus on Stealth checks equal to one half their class level for one hour.

Searing Smite (Su)

At 5th level the shadowpiercer can bring destruction on foes they have illuminated.

When they make a weapon attack against a creature illuminated by a spell of 1st level or higher that originated from the shadowpiercer (such as expending channel energy to cast faerie fire) they may expend a spell slot as part of that attack to gain a bonus on the attack roll equal to the level of the spell slot expended and deal additional damage equal to their class level.

Purifying Light (Su)

At 10th level the shadowpiercer can modify light spells you cast to damage foes.

Whenever you cast a spell with the light descriptor which affects an area you may expend a use of channel energy as part of casting that spell to have it deal 4d6 fire damage to any enemy in its area of effect. Creatures may make a Reflex saving throw with a DC equal to the 10 +1/2 your class level + your wisdom modifier to reduce this damage by half.
